item.title: Nearly 5m respiratory illness cases registered in 3 months: MoPH
item.description: The Ministry of Public Health (MoPH) says that nearly five million patients with respiratory illnesses, including 504 COVID-19 cases, were registered in government hospitals over the past three months.

item.title: Afghan information minister invited to Kazan forum in Russia
item.description: Russia has invited Afghanistan’s Minister of Information and Culture to participate in an upcoming economic, cultural, and tourism forum in Kazan, and has also indicated that a delegation from Russia’s Ministry of Culture will visit Kabul.

item.title: 25 tonnes of substandard batteries returned to Iran
item.description: Afghanistan’s Standards and Quality Authority has announced that a 25-tonne shipment of substandard batteries was returned to Iran from the western province of Farah following inspection and quality control.

item.title: Ariana airlines increases Kabul-New Delhi flights
item.description: Ariana Airlines has increased the number of cargo and passenger flights between Kabul and New Delhi to strengthen trade ties and expand transport capacity.

item.title: 2 killed, 3 injured in Farah wall collapse
item.description: At least two people were killed and three others injured after the wall of a house collapsed due to heavy rainfall in the Fararud district of western Farah province on Thursday.
